LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.ToggleDesc: Off by default. Turn on to sell this building’s stock while it is in a shop.
LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.ManageDesc: Open the storage management panel to configure sale status, prices, restock targets, and thresholds.
LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.Hint: Price 0 uses each item’s market value. Target 0 sells existing stock. Threshold −1 uses the target.
LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.WarningOff: Retail sales are currently off; customers will not buy items stored here. Click "Enable sales" above to turn it on.
LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.WarningNoShop: Retail sales are enabled, but this building is not inside a shop zone. Expand a shop zone over it so customers can browse it.
LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.HintFriendly: Price 0 uses each physical item’s market value (including quality and hit points). Target 0 sells existing stock; set a target above 0 to configure restock thresholds.
LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.Sort.Label: Sort: {mode}
LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.Batch.PriceMarket: Reset filtered prices to market value
LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.Batch.PriceMult: Set filtered prices to {mult}× market value
LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.Batch.TargetFromStock: Match restock targets to current stock
LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.MetaMarket: Base value {value} silver · Per-item market value
LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.MetaFixed: Base value {value} silver · Fixed unit price
LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.HostDisallowed: Blocked by host storage filter (restock paused)
LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.PriceMarketTip: Reset price to 0 to quote each item’s live market value (including quality and hit points).
LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.PriceCustomTip: Fill in the base market value as a fixed starting price.
LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.PriceFieldTip: Base market value: {value} silver. Enter 0 to use each item’s own market value, or a positive number for a fixed base price.
LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.TargetStepTip: Click for ±1; hold Shift for ±10; hold Ctrl for ±5. Set to 0 to sell existing stock without restocking.
LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.ThresholdDisabledTip: Set a restock target above 0 to configure the trigger threshold.
LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.ThresholdFieldTip: Restockers refill up to the target when current stock plus incoming stock drops to or below this value.
LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.RemoveRuleTip: Remove this out-of-stock item rule from the storage.
LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.ResetRuleTip: Reset to defaults (on sale, market value, no restock target).
LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.EmptyManage: No items match the current filter. Adjust the filter or switch to "Add items" to pre-configure goods for this storage.
LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.Picker.AddFilteredTip: Add all currently filtered items that are not yet in the list (up to {limit} at once).
LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.Picker.AddedTip: Already in draft list; click to remove.
LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.Picker.OnShelfTip: This item is physically stored in this building.
LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.Picker.Empty: No addable items match the current filter.
LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.RestockNowTip: Immediately trigger a restock cycle for all saved targets.
LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.PastePartial: Pasted {applied} rule(s); skipped {skipped} unsupported by this storage.
LanguageData.RSMF.StorageSales.PasteNone: No rules in clipboard apply to this storage.
